title: Clean Oracle-Free v2 AE + 4-Step DDGAN Bimodal Chain
intuition: Clean oracle-free v2 AE-DDGAN bimodal chain coupling a learned particle autoencoder with four public DDGAN reverse steps under terminal_observations=1 and a calibrated 900s budget, with zero host-owned whitening, cluster tethering, or div_loss.
failure_mode: Without host-side whitening or cluster tethering, moving latent coordinates from AE updates destabilize multimodal conditional DDGAN reverse fibers or collapse one of the two posterior modes.
protocol_notes: Clean oracle-free v2 benchmark (5,000 updates, 900s timeout); preserves legacy model_ae_ddgan_bimodal_chain untouched.
